need: Written before opening the document: what share of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions does the inventory attribute to energy-related activities in 2014, on a CO2-equivalent basis?
query: energy-related activities share of total U.S. greenhouse gas emissions 2014 CO2 equivalent basis percent

alternates.quote: Energy-related activities were the primary sources of U.S. anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions, accounting for 83.6 percent of total greenhouse gas emissions on a carbon dioxide (CO2) equivalent basis in 2014.

chain.title: Inventory of U.S. Greenhouse Gas Emissions and Sinks: 1990-2014
chain.author: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
